liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- Reviewer singles out the Memphis Blues performance as great [3]
- Reviewer also calls the West LA Fadeaway performance great [3]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd88-06-25 Sugaree**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [5]
- **gd88-06-25 Stuck Inside Of Mobile With The Memphis Blues Again**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [5]
- **gd88-07-31 Little Red Rooster**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [5]
- **gd88-07-31 West LA Fadeaway**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [5]

## The recordings

- **gd1988-06-25.135963.sbd.miller.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 4 songs; 34 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer describes the recording quality as very crisp [3]

## Around the show

- Stage talk about: gd88-06-25 [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1988-06-25.135963.sbd.miller.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: unknown lineage, dat tape fillers supplied by Charlie Miller [1]. Also: Soundboard source transferred from DAT using a Tascam DA-20 into a Sound Devices 744T, then processed in Samplitude Professional 11.2.1 and converted to FLAC [2]
